scene.bubble: Market day! We need fruit for the club milkshakes — and Luna is carrying the basket!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the fruit and vegetables.

words.clue: Small green or purple fruit that grow together.
A yellow fruit. It is very sour!
A big brown fruit with white inside and milk.
A long orange vegetable. Rabbits love it.
Peru has thousands of kinds of this vegetable!
A round vegetable that makes you cry when you cut it.

activities.title: Match the fruit with its colour.
Listen at the market. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Sofía (comprando) y Valentina (con la lista).
data.script: Valentina: The list says: fruit for milkshakes! … Sofia: Good morning! How much are the grapes? … Sofia: Two soles? We'll take one kilo, please. … Valentina: We need three pears and two kiwis too. … Sofia: And one coconut — Erik wants to open it with his new invention. … Valentina: That worries me a little. … Sofia: The basket is heavy now. Luna, your turn! … Valentina: Look at her — the proudest dog at the market!

outcomes.puede: Understand short dialogues with more vocabulary; identify main information in simple announcements.
Describe routines, favourites, community helpers; give short opinions.
Read short paragraphs; answer simple comprehension Qs; find specific info.
